60%  Gewürztraminer 40% Pinot Gris

A blend of sixty percent Gewürztraminer and forty percent Pinot Gris from the biodynamic vineyards of the Humbrecht family in Alsace. The grapes were fermented as whole bunches for ten days before being pressed off to cuve to rest until spring.
notas: A hazy shade of amber, the heady notes of quince and spice are offset by fine tannins and a bitterness that complements any exuberance beautifully.

uva:
100% Zibibbo

Suelo
    arenas volcánicas de piedra pómez y lapilli
Vinificación
    vendimia manual, vinificación separada de cada parcela, despalillado total de la uva, maceración variada de un día a tres semanas, fermentación espontánea con levaduras autóctonas en depósito de acero inoxidable o depósito de cerámica o barricas de castaño o depósito en en garrafa de cristal
notas: Expect a fresh orange wine bursting with peach, apricot, passion fruit, and orange, lifted by hints of honey, thyme, menthol, and wild herbs. Juicy, round, and full of sunshine artisan winemaking straight from European island vineyards, En dialecto pantescano, «Soki Soki» es el nombre de los suelos más típicos de la isla: arenas volcánicas de piedra pómez y lapilli. El término es una onomatopeya del sonido que se hace al caminar sobre ellas. Soki Soki proviene de 11 parcelas situadas en terrazas sobre la isla de Pantelleria, cada una media 30 áreas y tiene su propria microclima, inclinación. Este sitio ha sido declarado Patrimonio de la Humanidad por la UNESCO

notas: This parcel of old vines Gamay planted over granite in the Southern Beaujolais village of Bully was the one Katie made her first wine from way back when, and so she was very excited to harvest some fruit there again last year. uva:
80% Nero d'Avola and 20% Syrah

on calcareous and clay soils in the Pietra Rinosa and Fastuchera districts at 400 meters elevation on Monte Bonifato. Spontaneous fermentation occurs with native yeasts in stainless steel tanks, followed by six months aging in chestnut barrels. The wine is bottled unfined and unfiltered with minimal sulfites added.
notas: Intense ruby red color with bright clarity. The nose reveals cherry, blackberry, and purple floral notes with hints of Mediterranean herbs and black pepper. Medium-bodied palate delivers ripe red fruit with balsamic undertones, spicy crunchiness, and a fresh, taut finish reflecting Sicily's volcanic terroir.
